definitions.explanation: A person who has reached an exceptionally high level of skill or mastery in a particular field or art. Implies years of dedicated practice and deep expertise.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{料理|りょうり}→料理：01523_ryouri⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{達人|たつじん}だ。
examples.english: He is a master of cooking.

examples.japanese: ⟦{節約|せつやく}→節約：03302_setsuyaku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{達人|たつじん}⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧{本|ほん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{出|だ}した→出す：01087_dasu⟧。
examples.english: She published a book as a savings expert.

examples.japanese: ⟦{長年|ながねん}→長年：09684_naganen⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{修行|しゅぎょう}→修行：05522_shugyou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{経|へ}て→経る：13876_heru⟧、⟦{剣|けん}→剣：11819_ken⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{達人|たつじん}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{呼|よ}ばれる→呼ぶ：00766_yobu⟧ようになった。
examples.english: After years of training, he came to be called a master swordsman.

notes:
USAGE:
{達人|たつじん} implies a level of mastery beyond ordinary expertise. It can be used seriously (martial arts, traditional crafts) or more casually (cooking, saving money) in modern Japanese.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {達人|たつじん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{技|わざ}→技：02172_waza⟧ (a master's technique)
- {達人|たつじん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{学|まな}ぶ→学ぶ：01987_manabu⟧ (to learn from a master)
- 〜⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{達人|たつじん} (a master of...)

The word appears in popular culture through the rhythm game ⟦{太鼓|たいこ}→太鼓：04049_taiko⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{達人|たつじん} (Taiko no Tatsujin, "Taiko Master").

SIMILAR WORDS:
⟦{名人|めいじん}→名人：03753_meijin⟧ (master, champion) is similar but is also used as a formal title, especially in traditional games like shogi and go. {達人|たつじん} emphasizes the person's skill level rather than a title.
